verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents routines that start from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification, but only through Cursor account integrations [grok-bot-docs-32]. It also documents scheduled skills and routines that run without a human prompt [grok-bot-docs-31, grok-bot-docs-4]. Because event triggering depends on an extra account integration and no rule or condition model is documented, this is partial rather than full; the Auto Review rules only gate tool calls and do not trigger actions, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: native event triggers without a Cursor integration, documented user-defined rule conditions (filters/matching logic), a breadth of supported event sources beyond Slack/GitHub, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered routines.
